about.title: About Us
about.headline: A boutique agency with a personal touch
about.description1: Hakkenbroek Housing Company has been part of the Amsterdam property scene since 2000. From our office on Leliegracht, we have guided buyers, sellers, landlords, and tenants through the city’s most interesting transactions — always with discretion, always with care.
about.description2: We are not a volume agency. We are a trusted advisor. Our team combines deep Amsterdam market knowledge with an international perspective, serving clients from the Netherlands, across Europe, and beyond. We speak your language — literally and culturally.
about.description3: Our expertise extends beyond standard brokerage. We are specialists in Amsterdam’s historic monuments, canal houses, and the unique regulations that govern them. We advise on home styling that respects architectural heritage while creating spaces for modern living.
about.trustDesc: Confidentiality is the foundation of every relationship. What is discussed in our office stays in our office.
about.personalDesc: We take on a limited number of clients at any time. This ensures every client receives our full attention and the best of our network.
about.expertiseDesc: Over 25 years of Amsterdam transactions give us insight no algorithm can replicate. We know what a property is worth — and what it could be worth.
about.globalDesc: Multilingual support connecting Amsterdam properties with qualified buyers and renters from London, New York, Singapore, and beyond.
about.qualityDesc: We are selective about the properties we represent. If we would not recommend it to a friend, we will not list it.
about.relationshipsDesc: Most of our clients return. Many become friends. A property transaction is never just a transaction — it is the beginning of a relationship.
about.ctaDesc: Get in touch to discuss your property needs. We are here to listen, advise, and guide.
